notes: NCBI Plaque Psoriasis StatPearls updated 2025-09-14 was reread for the IL-23/IL-17 axis, keratinocyte hyperproliferation, acanthosis, parakeratosis, neutrophil recruitment and Munro microabscesses.
NLM/PMC reviews of the IL-23/IL-17 pathway were reread for IL-23 support of IL-17-producing lymphocytes and IL-17-mediated keratinocyte proliferation, chemokine production and neutrophil recruitment.
The official USMLE 2026 Skin & Subcutaneous Tissue outline was verified for psoriasis within immunologic/inflammatory disease.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

duplicate_gate.diagnosis: Plaque psoriasis driven by the IL-23/IL-17 axis

claim_audit.central_axis: The IL-23/IL-17 inflammatory axis is a central driver of plaque psoriasis.
claim_audit.il23_role: IL-23 supports maintenance/expansion of IL-17-producing immune cells.
claim_audit.il17_role: IL-17 acts on keratinocytes to promote proliferation and inflammatory gene/chemokine/antimicrobial-peptide production.
claim_audit.neutrophils: Keratinocyte-derived chemokines recruit neutrophils, which can aggregate in the stratum corneum as Munro microabscesses.
claim_audit.histology: Acanthosis, parakeratosis, reduced granular layer, dilated papillary vessels and neutrophilic microabscesses are established psoriatic findings.
claim_audit.distractor_1: IL-4/IL-13 dominant type-2 signaling is more characteristic of atopic dermatitis and barrier-protein suppression.
claim_audit.distractor_2: IFN-gamma macrophage activation and caseating granulomas do not define psoriasis.
claim_audit.distractor_3: IL-5/eosinophil/IgE biology is a type-2 allergic/eosinophilic pattern, not the dominant psoriatic pathway.
claim_audit.distractor_4: TGF-beta-driven fibrosis is inconsistent with the proliferative inflammatory epidermal pathology of plaque psoriasis.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The clinical morphology and histology establish plaque psoriasis. The question asks which cytokine interaction sustains both epidermal hyperplasia and neutrophilic inflammation; IL-23-supported IL-17-producing cells and IL-17-responsive keratinocytes explain both through a feed-forward inflammatory loop.
adversarial_second_pass.il22_nuance: IL-22 also contributes substantially to keratinocyte hyperproliferation and is produced by T17/T22 cells. The key does not claim IL-17 is the only cytokine; it asks for the interaction most directly sustaining the recognized central IL-23/IL-17 axis.
adversarial_second_pass.tnf_nuance: TNF-alpha is also central to psoriasis and synergizes with IL-17. The answer deliberately describes a major axis rather than excluding TNF participation.
adversarial_second_pass.th17_source_nuance: IL-17 is not produced only by classical CD4 Th17 cells; Tc17, gamma-delta T cells, ILCs and other cells can contribute. The option therefore says IL-17-producing lymphocytes rather than overrestricting the source.
adversarial_second_pass.munro_specificity: Munro microabscesses support psoriasis but are not used as a standalone pathognomonic feature; the diagnosis rests on the full clinical/histologic pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: All answer choices pair an immune cytokine pathway with a downstream tissue effect. The correct option is not the only plausible immunologic mechanism.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No cell-turnover-day value, cytokine concentration, treatment-response percentage or HLA prevalence is used.
